classification: exact byte correspondence only; does not identify code/data or prove runtime relocation

delta_sweep.note: The same v1.08-selected anchor may not represent homologous content in older releases; interpret peaks alongside exact-run evidence.

limitations: A constant file-offset delta does not prove runtime relocation; it can arise from reordered/copyable data or a transformed container layout.
Byte equality does not classify code, data, compression, or execution state.
The delta sweep is local to one selected 4 KiB anchor and is not a global alignment search.
